# Mark II v0.2.0-alpha1 Black/White and split toning

The project describes Black and White on the tone page and Shadow, Midtone and Highlight Tint on the colour wheel of Color Profiles 1–3.

**Camera:** [OM SYSTEM OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md) · **Project:** [Caduceus for OM-5](../projects/caduceus-om5.md)

**Firmware:** [om5-ii firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om5-ii-1100.md) · **Mod build:** v0.2.0-alpha1

The project describes Black and White on the tone page and Shadow, Midtone and Highlight Tint on the colour wheel of Color Profiles 1–3, with live-view updates without a half-press.

**Availability:** published release. **Implementation basis:** reported.

## Limits
